# Pilot plane recovery

Used in [Air Game — air combat and flak](/rules/air/70-air-combat-and-flak).

## Table

| Die | Strafed | Shot down |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Plane: repairable | Plane: repairable; Pilot: survives |
| 2 | Plane: repairable | Plane: lost; Pilot: survives |
| 3–6 | Plane: lost | Plane: lost; Pilot: killed |

## Notes

- Pilot and Plane Recovery Table, 45.6, chart page 10 (jp2 104). Read twice, from the archive.org scan and the community chart PDFs (Shared Charts.pdf p. 10): 0 of 6 cells differ.
- One die per aircraft. strafed: any aircraft destroyed on the ground by strafing. shot_down: fighters and fighter-bombers lost air to air or to flak, with their pilots. plane: repairable or lost; pilot: survives or killed.
- Under the table: recovery is tried, and 1 fuel and 1 stores spent per repairable aircraft, in the first maintenance segment or phase after the loss; a repaired aircraft starts unfuelled, unarmed and unfit, and no maintenance may be done on it until a full Game-Turn after the roll; a surviving pilot rejoins his squadron one Game-Turn after the roll.
